title: $\Delta\tau$-Bench: Pushing Agents Toward a Moving Capability
abstract: arXiv:2610.34238v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we introduce $\Delta\tau$-Bench, an executable agent benchmark that models the structural evolution of large tool ecosystems. In $\Delta\tau$-Bench, independently evolving services continually reshape how tasks can be accomplished: familiar tools may disappear or be replaced, while more efficient alternatives emerge amid overlapping functionality and noisy documentation. Against this moving capability frontier, we evaluate whether agents can proactively discover efficient tool-use paths and promptly revise their accumulated procedural knowledge, bringing together demands that existing benchmarks fail to examine. $\Delta\tau$-Bench comprises 1,588 validated multi-turn tasks across 42 domains and six successive ecosystem states generated through capability-preserving transformations. translated_title: Δτ-Bench：推动智能体迈向动态变化的能力边界
translated_abstract: 本文提出了Δτ-Bench，一个可执行的智能体基准测试，用于建模大型工具生态系统的结构演化。在Δτ-Bench中，各自独立演化的服务不断重塑任务的完成方式：熟悉的工具可能消失或被替换，而更高效的替代方案则会在功能重叠和充满噪声的文档中涌现。面对这一不断移动的能力边界，我们评估智能体能否主动发现高效的工具使用路径，并及时修订其积累的程序性知识，从而汇集了现有基准测试未能考察的多重需求。Δτ-Bench包含1,588个经过验证的多轮任务，覆盖42个领域，以及通过能力保持变换生成的六个连续的生态系统状态。我们的评估显示，即使是最强的被评估模型或框架，其任务成功率也仅为42.3%，而现有方法带来的初始收益……
tldr: Δτ-Bench是一个模拟工具生态系统持续演化的可执行智能体基准测试，包含覆盖42个领域的1,588个多轮任务，评估显示最强模型的任务成功率也仅达42.3%，揭示了智能体在应对工具环境动态变化方面的重大不足。
en_tdlr: Δτ-Bench is an executable agent benchmark modeling the continuous evolution of tool ecosystems, comprising 1,588 multi-turn tasks across 42 domains, revealing that even the strongest models achieve only 42.3% task success when adapting to shifting tool environments.
